intro: Martek the Exiled in the Badlands has news about indurium for Fizzle Brassbolts. You carry Martek's message back to the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Indurium has an amazing resistance to heat! I'm sure it will work for Fizzle's pistons. But he'll need true indurium ore, not just the flakes.
To get the ore, it must be mined from deep within Uldaman, on the northern borders of the Badlands. That is the true source of indurium.
Send Fizzle Brassbolts my regards, and tell him what I told you.
Safe travels, friend. And it won't surprise me if we meet again -- once Fizzle learns of indurium he'll probably send you to Uldaman to acquire it!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Friend, you're back! You found Martek? You spoke with him? What did he say? Can he help??
Tell me, tell me, tell me!!
